wikipediaArticleRead.support: L115–124 identifies Tabrimmon as an Aramaean king, son of Hezion and father of Ben-Hadad, and quotes 1 Kings 15:18. It notes alternate spellings, none of which change the Kings identity.

Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
